ruling: UNCOUNTABLE-AS-SCALAR. No bare number is citeable — not 11, 12, 9, 5, 8, 10, or 22. Counted-statements WITH a stated (inclusion, granularity, unit) triple are derivable from this table (e.g. 12 actor-triggered instances at heading granularity; 8 citing-sub-defects at sub-defect granularity). The four numbers in the brief are four points in an unconstrained space, not candidates. Citeable form: THIS TABLE plus the triple. This CONFIRMS the CURRENT STATE block's stance ('Any future citation must name which of the four it means') and supplies the table the 'five' debt demanded.
